# PulseChat — Real-Time WebSocket Messaging System
> Enterprise-grade real-time messaging engine built with Node.js, WebSockets, Redis Pub/Sub, PostgreSQL, and React.js.

## Overview
PulseChat provides room-based messaging, direct messaging, typing telemetry, emoji reactions, presence tracking, and browser extension integrations (including Ponytail extension hooks) with sub-50ms latency.

## Architecture
- **Protocol**: Raw WebSockets over `ws://` / `wss://` with JSON payload frame envelopes.
- **Message Mesh**: Redis Pub/Sub distributed across server clusters with local in-memory fallback.
- **Persistence**: PostgreSQL relational storage with automatic SQLite fallback for isolated local development.
- **Client**: React 19 + TypeScript + Vite with zero source map leakage and code-split vendor bundles.

## Key Endpoints
- `GET /healthz`: Cluster health check and uptime status.
- `GET /api/stats`: Active connection count, room distribution, and memory telemetry.
- `GET /api/rooms`: List public rooms and participant counts.
- `GET /api/rooms/:roomId/messages`: Retrieve historical room message backlog.
- `WS /ws`: Real-time WebSocket duplex connection gateway.

## Supported WebSocket Frames
- Client-to-Server: `AUTH`, `JOIN_ROOM`, `LEAVE_ROOM`, `SEND_MESSAGE`, `TYPING_START`, `TYPING_STOP`, `ADD_REACTION`, `HEARTBEAT`
- Server-to-Client: `AUTH_SUCCESS`, `ROOM_HISTORY`, `NEW_MESSAGE`, `USER_TYPING`, `PRESENCE_UPDATE`, `REACTION_UPDATED`, `PONG`, `ERROR`

## Extension Integration (Ponytail)
PulseChat features a dedicated browser extension bridge enabling side-panel docking, canned reply insertion, and event telemetry via `window.postMessage` API.
